text: {"assertions":["A plan drift issue in infra/terraform/vpc.tf was caused by comparing naive datetime objects against timezone-aware ones","The plan drift fix involved making all boundary datetimes timezone-aware at the edge of the VPC module","The plan drift fix was implemented in PR #1520 on branch fix/plan-drift-1","The plan drift issue could be reproduced by running terraform plan twice consecutively with no code changes between runs","After implementing the timezone-aware fix, memory usage stabilized at 173 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB","The plan drift manifested as unexpected resource diffs on infrastructure that had not been modified","The issue only became apparent after the client had already retried the operation once","This plan drift work was a continuation of earlier infrastructure issues in the same area of infra/terraform/vpc.tf"]}
